title: DAILY RESTORE ACTION AND SECTION
why: The critic found equal-weight restore controls, an ambiguous undo hint and a display section marker while the save row was focused. Give the existing save section its missing navigation entry and make restore the primary action.
now: Settings marks saves and tools while its restore row is focused. Restore is the primary action, undo stays secondary, dated details are compact, and the two nearby key hints are readable.
